title: Venezuelan Shrimp Skewers
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dish from Venezuela, featuring succulent shrimp marinated in a mixture of spices and grilled to perfection on skewers.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers, leaving a little space between each shrimp.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Transfer the skewers to a plate and garnish with lovely (chopped fresh cilantro or parsley).
